answer: Per-action micro-bonds resist sybils: every attestation or grade an identity casts must be backed by its own at-risk deposit, not a one-time registration fee. Casting a hundred votes means locking a hundred bonds, so cost scales linearly with the identity count a swarm fields — no free echo of one paid-up account. A single caught lie burns every bond staked on correlated votes, so a fake fleet's whole voyage forfeits at once. The sybil finds no oasis of cheap scale; each clone is a fresh pigment that must be bought, never copied.
